name: NCT
recent: NCT Alliance 近期宣布以 RM53 million 认购 Semanja Murni 80% 股权，并延长以 RM22 million 收购 NCT Marina Bay 51% 股权的条件期限。公司同时与 Sidec 合作开发雪兰莪机器人制造中心，并推出 NCT Smart Industrial Park 第二期。最新季度营收同比下滑 56.9%，但净利环比增长 32.8%。
notable: 条件期限延长至 2026 年 12 月 19 日。
与 Sidec 合作在雪兰莪开发机器人制造中心。
risks: 执行主席兼集团董事经理 Dato' Sri Yap Ngan Choy 及集团执行董事 Dato' Yap Fook Choy 在 2026 年 8 月 27 日及 9 月 2 日分别间接减持 10,500,000 股。
公司持续进行股份回购。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM87.1 million，环比下降 10.6%，同比下降 56.9%；净利为 RM20.5 million，环比增长 32.8%，同比下降 16.7%；净利率为 23.6%，高于上一季度的 15.9%。

recent_en: NCT Alliance recently announced a RM53 million subscription for an 80% stake in Semanja Murni and extended the conditional period for its RM22 million acquisition of a 51% stake in NCT Marina Bay. The company also partnered with Sidec to develop a Selangor robotics manufacturing hub and launched Phase 2 of NCT Smart Industrial Park. Latest quarterly revenue fell 56.9% YoY, while net profit rose 32.8% QoQ.
notable_en: Proposed subscription of an 80% enlarged stake in Semanja Murni for RM53 million.
Proposed acquisition of a 51% stake in NCT Marina Bay for RM22 million, with the conditional period extended to 19 December 2026.
Partnership with Sidec to develop a robotics manufacturing hub in Selangor.
risks_en: Executive Chairman/Group Managing Director Dato' Sri Yap Ngan Choy and Group Executive Director Dato' Yap Fook Choy each indirectly disposed of 10,500,000 shares on 27 August 2026 and 2 September 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM87.1 million, down 10.6% QoQ and 56.9% YoY; net profit was RM20.5 million, up 32.8% QoQ but down 16.7% YoY; net margin was 23.6%, higher than 15.9% in the previous quarter.
